existing_classification.classification_leakage_risk: MODERATE — sector labels may change over time (GICS reclassifications)
existing_classification.survivorship_risk: LOW — instruments are from universe files, not survivorship-filtered

pit_risks.risk: GICS reclassifications may introduce look-ahead bias
pit_risks.mitigation: Use historical sector labels, not current labels. If historical labels unavailable, document limitation.

pit_risks.risk: Sector membership changes over time (additions/removals from universe)
pit_risks.mitigation: Use instrument master configs which reflect historical membership.

pit_risks.risk: Small sectors may have insufficient observations for robust analysis
pit_risks.mitigation: Document sector observation counts. Consider grouping small sectors.

required_additional_data.description: Historical GICS sector classifications with effective dates
required_additional_data.priority: HIGH — needed to avoid look-ahead bias

sector_feature_inventory.name: Sector 20-Day Return
sector_feature_inventory.definition: Mean of 20-day returns for instruments in same sector
sector_feature_inventory.economic_mechanism: Sector-level momentum may capture sector-specific information flows

sector_feature_inventory.name: Sector 20-Day Volatility
sector_feature_inventory.definition: Standard deviation of 20-day returns for instruments in same sector
sector_feature_inventory.economic_mechanism: Sector-level volatility may capture sector-specific risk conditions

sector_feature_inventory.name: Sector Return Dispersion
sector_feature_inventory.definition: Standard deviation of cross-sectional returns within sector
sector_feature_inventory.economic_mechanism: High dispersion may indicate sector uncertainty or idiosyncratic risk
